newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Sept trade surplus rises to 121.6 mln Sfr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Sept trade surplus rises to 121.6 mln Sfr.

text.p: Switzerland's trade surplus rose to 121.6 million Swiss francs in September from a revised 6.3 million surplus in August, the Federal Customs Office said.
Note - Original August figures reported on September 17 showed a surplus of 11.1 million francs, imports of 6,187.7 million and exports of 6,198.8 million.

The figures above are for all goods except precious metals, precious stones, art objects and antiques. The following figures comprise trade in all goods, including precious metals, precious stones, art objects and antiques.
Note - Original August surplus was 77.4 million francs, imports 6,420.1 million and exports 6,487.5 million.
